entries.0bcddce832ea7c3a: A reportable segment engaged in buying, renovating and reselling used condominiums, asset management related to the development of facilities for the elderly, and operating trunk rooms; of the two reportable segments, it is the one with the larger operating revenue from external customers. For used condominiums, My Place Co., Ltd. buys and resells them in the Tokyo metropolitan area and the Kinki region, Bautec Group Co., Ltd. handles the design and construction of renovations, and My Planner Co., Ltd. is also part of the same group. EW Asset Management Co., Ltd. is in charge of developing facilities for the elderly, and My Trunk Co., Ltd. of trunk rooms. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, operating revenue in the MD&A table was ¥52,257 million (up 27.1% from the previous year), and segment profit was ¥4,702 million (up 62.1%). Used condominiums purchased numbered 847 units (777 units in the previous year), units sold numbered 880 (904 units in the previous year), and Bautec Group Co., Ltd. completed 1,085 units (1,055 units in the previous year). The Annual Securities Report states that higher unit selling prices, mainly for properties in central Tokyo, which improved the profit margin, and the sale of facilities for the elderly contributed to the increase in revenue and profit.

entries.35c9f083ce23b9e4: In the securities-related business, in addition to retail clients and clients introduced through contracted intermediaries, it is expanding business alliances with regional financial institutions, such as Aichi Shinkin Bank (October 2025), Boso Credit Cooperative (February 2026) and Kosan Shinkin Bank (March 2026). The real estate-related business sells used condominiums to first-time homebuyers and also provides renovation design and construction services to external purchase-and-resale operators. The annual securities report states that information on major customers is omitted because operating revenue from any specific customer is less than 10% of sales in the income statement.
entries.3f2cc835289587da: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,277 million (¥4,170 million in the previous fiscal year, up 50.5%), ordinary profit was ¥6,269 million (up 61.2%), and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥4,052 million (up 54.0%). Segment profit in the MD&A table was ¥2,446 million for the securities-related business (up 14.5%) and ¥4,702 million for the real estate-related business (up 62.1%). The annual securities report states that improved profit margins, supported by a favorable market environment for used condominiums, and the sale of facilities for the elderly were the reasons for higher profit in the real estate-related business.

entries.960474e193bc927c: Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥68,718 million, up 20.7% from ¥56,928 million in the previous fiscal year. In the securities-related business, both fee and commission income and trading gains and losses expanded, and in the real estate-related business, higher selling prices, mainly for properties in central urban areas, and the sale of facilities for the elderly contributed, so both businesses posted higher revenue. The previous-year figures are those after investment income on foreign-currency deposits at Akatsuki Securities Co., Ltd. was changed from non-operating income to financial income within operating revenue.

entries.a0b9789721ae4c10: A reportable segment engaged in the buying and selling of securities and the brokerage of orders for such trades, and the underwriting, offering, and handling of offerings and secondary offerings of securities. Its core is Akatsuki Securities, Inc., which, in addition to retail sales, makes its main business financial instruments intermediary services, supporting customers together with financial instruments intermediary service providers (IFAs); its subsidiary Japan Wealth Advisors Co., Ltd. is a financial instruments intermediary service provider. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, operating revenue in the MD&A table was ¥16,702 million (up 3.9% from the previous year), and segment profit was ¥2,446 million (up 14.5%). As of the end of March 2026, assets under custody, including assets under management at the partner financial institutions of Japan Wealth Advisors Co., Ltd., were ¥803.8 billion (up ¥177.7 billion from the end of March 2025), and assets under custody in the IFA division were ¥522.4 billion (up ¥122.1 billion). In April 2025, the company acquired additional ordinary shares of Shin Securities Sakamoto Co., Ltd., making it an equity-method affiliate (33.4% voting rights held).
entries.a646940dd2250275: Sales of used condominiums (number of units sold in the fiscal year ended March 2026: 880)
entries.af97751153908e90: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that the company, as a holding company, formulates group-wide investment strategy and makes decisions on resource allocation within the group, and that the group conducts its securities-related and real estate-related businesses through the company, 16 subsidiaries and three affiliates. The securities-related business is centered on Akatsuki Securities Co., Ltd., which conducts retail sales and a financial product intermediary business that works with financial product intermediaries (IFA). The real estate-related business conducts the purchase and resale of used condominiums and renovation, asset management related to the development of facilities for the elderly, and trunk room operation. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥68,718 million; in the MD&A table, the securities-related business accounted for ¥16,702 million and the real estate-related business for ¥52,257 million (both include intersegment internal operating revenue). The business risks section states that, as a pure holding company, the company’s revenue depends in principle on dividends received from its subsidiaries.
